There are a lot of invisible illnesses like Ehlers-Danlos, Lupus or Rheumatoid Arthritis that can leave a seemingly healthy looking person disabled, even though it appears they're completely normal from the outside.

Many disabled people may be able to walk short distances but they aren't able to walk or stand for long and they're in constant pain but you'd never know it to look at them.

It's because of invisible disabilities that the no questioning rules are in place. Obviously this leaves the system open to abuse but there isn't much the airline will be able to do about your complaint.
